scripts.generate:router-ab-ed25519-yao-types: UPDATE_ROUTER_AB_ED25519_YAO_TYPES=1 cargo test --manifest-path crates/router-ab-core/Cargo.toml --features typescript-bindings --test export_typescript_bindings -- --nocapture
scripts.build:sdk-dev: pnpm -C packages/sdk-web run build:sdk-full && ROUTER_AB_WORKER_BUILD_PROFILE=dev pnpm router:build
scripts.build:sdk-full: pnpm -C packages/sdk-web run build:sdk-full && pnpm router:build
scripts.build:sdk-prod: pnpm -C packages/sdk-web run build:prod && ROUTER_AB_WORKER_BUILD_PROFILE=release pnpm router:build
scripts.format:rust: bash -lc 'for dir in wasm/*_signer; do (cd "$dir" && cargo fmt); done'
scripts.format:rust:check: bash -lc 'for dir in wasm/*_signer; do (cd "$dir" && cargo fmt -- --check); done'
scripts.lint:rust: bash -lc 'for dir in wasm/*_signer; do (cd "$dir" && cargo clippy --all-targets); done'
scripts.lint:rust:strict: bash -lc 'for dir in wasm/*_signer; do (cd "$dir" && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings); done'
scripts.type-check:router-server: pnpm -C packages/sdk-web run build:types && pnpm -C apps/web-server exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.type-check:app: pnpm -C packages/sdk-web run build:types && pnpm -C apps/seams-site exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.type-check: pnpm -s type-check:sdk && pnpm -s type-check:router-server && pnpm -s type-check:app && pnpm -s type-check:docs
scripts.check: pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s type-check && pnpm -s check:docs-links && pnpm -s check:docs-fences && pnpm -s format:rust:check && pnpm -s lint:rust && pnpm -s check:signing-architecture && pnpm -s check:signer-parity
scripts.site:serve: concurrently --kill-others --names caddy,site,docs "pnpm run caddy" "node ./scripts/start-local-site.mjs" "pnpm run docs:dev"
scripts.gateway:server: export SEAMS_D1_LOCAL_PERSIST_TO="${SEAMS_D1_LOCAL_PERSIST_TO:-../../.local/cloudflare-state/gateway}"; export SEAMS_D1_LOCAL_WRANGLER_CONFIG="${SEAMS_D1_LOCAL_WRANGLER_CONFIG:-wrangler.d1-local.toml}"; pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names sdk,d1 "pnpm -C packages/sdk-server-ts build" "pnpm -C packages/console-server-ts run d1:local:prepare" && pnpm -C packages/console-server-ts run d1:local:serve
scripts.gateway:server:threshold-3nodes: pnpm -C packages/sdk-server-ts build && HOST=127.0.0.1 EXPECTED_ORIGIN=https://localhost EXPECTED_WALLET_ORIGIN=https://localhost:8443 ROUTER_AB_NORMAL_SIGNING_WORKER_ID=${ROUTER_AB_NORMAL_SIGNING_WORKER_ID:-local-signing-worker} ROUTER_AB_SIGNING_WORKER_URL=${ROUTER_AB_SIGNING_WORKER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:9103} ROUTER_AB_INTERNAL_SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET=${ROUTER_AB_INTERNAL_SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET:-dev-router-ab-internal-service-auth} pnpm -C apps/web-server dev:threshold:3relays
scripts.gateway:server:iphone: pnpm -C packages/sdk-server-ts build && HOST=0.0.0.0 EXPECTED_ORIGIN=https://pta-m4.local EXPECTED_WALLET_ORIGIN=https://pta-m4.local:8443 ROUTER_AB_NORMAL_SIGNING_WORKER_ID=${ROUTER_AB_NORMAL_SIGNING_WORKER_ID:-local-signing-worker} ROUTER_AB_SIGNING_WORKER_URL=${ROUTER_AB_SIGNING_WORKER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:9103} ROUTER_AB_INTERNAL_SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET=${ROUTER_AB_INTERNAL_SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET:-dev-router-ab-internal-service-auth} pnpm -C apps/web-server dev
scripts.benchmark:router-ab-ecdsa-derivation:was: bash -lc 'if [ -z "${CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown:-}" ] && [ -x /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang ]; then export CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown=/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang; fi; cd wasm/router_ab_ecdsa_signing_worker && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg && cd ../router_ab_ecdsa_client && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg && cd ../.. && node ./benchmarks/router-ab-ecdsa-derivation-wasm/src/runner.mjs'
